verdict.rationale: Formant's product page says users can "ask your fleet what's happening in plain language" and get ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. Its analytics docs also mention an AI assistant for building dashboards. Together these are first-party natural-language features, but they cover querying and dashboard building more than directly operating robots or issuing commands in plain language. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command execution, in-depth docs on the plain-language interface's scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
